text: せかい　じゅうを　たび　してきたが　ねむって　ばかりの　あいつを　みつけたときは　ほんとに　あきれた　たしか…！

structure.jp: せかい　じゅうを　たび　してきたが
structure.en: I've traveled all over the world, but

structure.jp: ねむって　ばかりの　あいつを　みつけたときは
structure.en: when I found that one that did nothing but sleep

structure.jp: ほんとに　あきれた

patterns.name: 〜てばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a て form means doing nothing but that. ねむって ばかり = 'doing nothing but sleeping'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て form says something has been going on up to now. たび してきた = 'have been traveling until now'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a verb means 'when' that happened. みつけたときは = 'when I found it'.
